name: cl_fx_fvg_noside_15_p37

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20, falsify lens: CONTROL for the open-side FVG leader -- the same 15-minute FVG retest with NO side rule. If the 09:30 open's side is the edge, gaps bought and sold on both sides earn far less than the leader; if they earn as much, the side is decoration and the plain FVG retest (unfilled orders left in the gap, the faders pay) carries it.

entry.words: Any 15-minute fair value gap of the session pass, up or down, at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high: a limit at its near edge, with the gap (an up gap is bought, a down gap sold), whatever side of the 09:30 open price is on. The newest gap replaces an older resting order. No new order from 15:00. Stop 37 points, target 37 points (1:1, the leader's median middle-candle stop). One trade per session pass.

taught: [owner 2026-10-06, families/fvg.py] the fair value gap as an entry trigger: a limit at the gap's near edge, with the gap
[chat 2026-10-19, sheet cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1] NQ, 15-minute bars, 1:1, gaps at least 0.1 x ATR

[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] CONTROL: the open-side rule is REMOVED (both sides traded); stop and target fixed at 37 points = the leader's median stop and the stop its random control used; one per session pass; no new order from 15:00
not_run: THE SIDE RULE IS REMOVED ON PURPOSE: this is a control, not a strategy.

THE STOP: 37 points fixed, not the middle candle's extreme (fvg's own structure stop is the gap's far edge, a much tighter stop; a fixed stop keeps the size equal to the leader's median and to its random control).

ENGINE DIFFERENCES FROM THE LEADER (fvg, not fvg_oside): one instance per session pass (nyam 09:30-11:00, mid 11:00-13:30, pm 13:30 on), so a gap's three candles must lie inside one pass and a gap cannot span 11:00 or 13:30; the cap is one per pass (up to three a day) instead of two a day; the newest gap of EITHER side replaces the resting order.
WINDOW: no new order from 15:00 (w_end); an order placed before 15:00 may still fill after it (fvg has no 15:00 cancel).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay, strict limit fills).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
